title: GOOD: whitelist_check helper isolates logic for fast unit tests
description: The test helper whitelist_check() in config.rs tests extracts the normalization + CIDR containment logic as a pure synchronous function. Tests T4-T8 that use it are plain #[test] functions (not #[tokio::test]), so they run without spawning a runtime, without binding TCP sockets, and without the async overhead of drive_session_ext. This isolation also makes the tests more precise: they target only the IP normalization and CIDR lookup logic, not the full session lifecycle. The alternative — testing whitelist behavior through the full drive_session_ext harness — would require engineering IPv4-mapped peer addresses in test connections (which depends on OS dual-stack socket behavior) and would conflate session behavior with the IP lookup logic being tested. The helper approach gives fast, deterministic, portable tests with a clear oracle.
